subject: ggvis categorical bar plot with fill

messages.author: 1fa5c1dd06a95a96
messages.subject: ggvis categorical bar plot with fill
parts:
Hi,

I have been using ggplot2 for several years now, and I am trying to make the switch from ggplot2 to ggvis(). However, I cannot find how to make a categorical bar plot. Any help in the right direction would be greatly appreciated, thanks! James

#### R Code ####
needed_packages <- c("ggvis", "dplyr", "data.table", "ggplot2")
sapply(needed_packages, require, character.only=TRUE)

dt_1 <-
  data.table(
    group = c(rep("a", 3), rep("b", 3), rep("c", 3)),
    frequency = sample(15:30, replace=TRUE, size=9),
    year = c(rep(2011:2013, 3))
    )

# this is what I was doing in ggplot2, which I want to do exactly the same way in ggvis
ggplot(data=dt_1, aes(x=group, y=frequency, fill=factor(year) ) )+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position=position_dodge(0.5), width=0.5, color="black")

# works
dt_1 %>%
  ggvis(~group, ~frequency, fill = ~factor(year) ) %>%
  layer_points()

# empty graph???
dt_1 %>%
  ggvis(~group, ~frequency ) %>%
  layer_rects()

# works - seems to be close to what I want
dt_1 %>%
  ggvis(~group, ~frequency ) %>%
  layer_bars()

# does not work - wish it did like the layer_points above
dt_1 %>%
  ggvis(~group, ~frequency, fill = ~factor(year) ) %>%
  layer_bars()

# does not work, seems that only numeric x and y vectors allowed
dt_1 %>% ggvis(~group, ~frequency, fill := "#fff8dc") %>%
  layer_histograms()
